# The enrolled population of the preparation-split capture, in the format
# scripts/floor_preparation_capture.sh reads: `candidate|<module>|<claim>` for claims eligible for
# the graded capture and `extra|<module>|<claim>` for claims enrolled ONLY so their refusal stays in
# the artifact. Both legs are built from this one file, so a claim cannot be enrolled in one leg and
# quietly dropped from the other. Generated by the enumeration in the node's measure-first step;
# regenerate with the same claim enumeration, never by hand.
